Software development is an integral part of my methodological research. The packages below provide implementations of statistical methods developed in my work and make them available for practical data analysis.

::: {.software-grid}
::: {.software-card}
### CovCorTest
**Inference for Covariance and Correlation Structures**

An R package for testing general hypotheses about covariance and correlation matrices in multivariate designs. It supports comparisons between groups as well as inference for specified structures and patterns.

[CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=CovCorTest){data-goatcounter-click="software-cran-covcortest-page"} ·
[GitHub](https://github.com/sjedhoff/CovCorTest){data-goatcounter-click="software-github-covcortest"} ·
[Details](software/covcortest.qmd)
:::

::: {.software-card}
### hdrm
**High-Dimensional Repeated-Measures Inference**

An R package implementing methodology for statistical inference in high-dimensional repeated-measures and split-plot designs.

[Details](software/hdrm.qmd)
:::

::: {.software-card}
### HypoShrink
**Simplifying Linear Hypotheses for Efficient Inference**

An R package for simplifying and comparing linear hypotheses in quadratic-form-based inference.

[GitHub](https://github.com/PaavoSattler/HypoShrink){data-goatcounter-click="software-github-hyposhrink-page"} ·
[Zenodo DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17214498){data-goatcounter-click="software-doi-hyposhrink-page"} ·
[Details](software/hyposhrink.qmd)
:::
